name: sajha_ask
description:
Answers a natural-language question by letting SAJHA choose and run its own tools (Ask SAJHA as an LLM tool, mode answer). Inner calls run with the caller's own permissions; ai.ask.mcp_allowed_tools can narrow the tools it may use. Switched on and off by ai.ask.mcp_tool_enabled.
Returns: answer, confidence, citations (the tool calls relied on), caveats, steps, models, planner, conversation_id and stopped_by (answer, a limit, needs_confirmation, needs_connection or error); pending lists destructive calls waiting for approval (with fingerprints) and connections lists accounts to link.
Inputs (* required): question*; model (model alias or provider/model; default the tool's model); conversation_id (follow-up within 24 hours, up to 20 turns); confirm (fingerprints from pending that the user approved).
For documentation questions sajha_search_docs or llm_docs_qa is cheaper.
Example: {"question": "Compare the Bank of Canada policy rate with the US federal funds rate."}

question.description: The question to answer with SAJHA's tools.

model.description: Model alias or provider/model (default: the tool's model, ai.llm_tools.default_model).

conversation_id.description: From a previous answer, to continue that conversation.

confirm.description: Fingerprints of destructive tool calls the user has confirmed.
